name: Snapchat
summary: Enable Ghost Mode to hide your location, restrict who can contact you, and enable 2FA.

settings.name: Ghost Mode (Snap Map)
settings.impact: Snap Map broadcasts your precise real-time location to all your friends by default. Ghost Mode hides your location from everyone — a critical safety measure, especially for minors.
settings.source: Snapchat Support: Snap Map Privacy & Safety Reminder; Total Defense Security Blog

settings.name: Who Can Contact Me
settings.impact: Anyone can send you snaps and messages by default. Restricting to Friends significantly reduces spam, harassment, and phishing attempts from strangers.
settings.source: Snapchat Support: Security and Safety Steps

settings.name: Who Can View My Story
settings.impact: Stories are visible to all contacts by default. Limiting visibility prevents acquaintances or lapsed contacts from tracking your daily activities.

settings.name: See Me in Quick Add
settings.impact: Quick Add shows your profile to friends-of-friends as a suggested contact. Disabling reduces your discoverability to people you have not chosen to connect with.

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: Snapchat account takeovers can expose private photos and messages. An authenticator app provides significantly stronger protection than SMS verification.
